Teach Live
Start & setup
More information
?
AI Backend Settings

FIRST-TIME SETUP · CHOOSE YOUR AI

AlloFlow uses an AI engine to create lessons, read aloud, and answer questions. Pick how you'd like it to work — you can change this any time.

🚀
Use AlloFlow inside Gemini Canvas
NO SETUP

The easiest way to get AI: open AlloFlow inside Google Gemini. Free with a Google account, using your Gemini plan's daily quota (personal, Education, or paid plans all work). Nothing to install and no key to manage.

Opens gemini.google.com in a new tab. Plan details at google.com/gemini

✨
Google Gemini
RECOMMENDED

Best quality and speed. Runs in Google's cloud with a free key — we'll walk you through getting one (about 2 minutes).

Works anywhere · needs internet

🔒
Private AI on this computer
MOST PRIVATE

Everything stays on this computer — no account, no internet needed after setup. One click downloads a starter AI model.

8 GB+ memory recommended · ~2.5 GB one-time download

🔌
An AI app I already run

Already use LM Studio, Ollama, or LocalAI on this computer? Connect it.

Saved work on this device

Open your saved resource packs to restore, pin, export, or erase them. Also shows space used and the offline voice models such as Whisper and Kokoro.

Open saved work
▼
Advanced settings
